lines.text: David defeats the Philistines and takes Gath, then defeats the Moabites, who become subject to him and bring tribute.
David defeats King Hadadezer of Zobah, captures a thousand chariots, and hamstrings all the horses except a hundred.
David strikes down twenty-two thousand Arameans of Damascus, places garrisons there, and the LORD makes him victorious wherever he goes.
David brings the gold shields of Hadadezer's officers to Hebron, and Absalom later makes the bronze Sea from the bronze.
Abishai son of Zeruiah strikes down eighteen thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt and places garrisons in Moab.
